x-openregister._seedDataNote: Schemas only. A register.d fragment declares no objects; the example sets live in lib/Settings/profiles/.

_comment: ADR-037 register fragment (list values concatenate on merge, so an enum here names only the value it adds), change publication-theme-pages (REQ-THP-001, REQ-THP-003, matrix row pub-20). A theme (slug governance-theme: the plain slug theme is global on a shared OpenRegister and thematiq owns theming) gathers the meetings, agenda items, decisions, commitments and long-term agenda items of one long-running topic. Publishing it writes a payload whose timeline holds only the linked items that are published themselves.
